goal: Reduce real costs of fast and retained rendering for Fincode while preserving correctness and responsiveness
iteration: Reuse all/own dependency snapshot for a nested recording with no reads
primary_target: At least 40% less held and peak dependency heap for 1024 empty nested records; no app cache or new app fields
timing_gate: Paired median CPU/elapsed increases must fit baseline max-minus-min; primary improvement must be larger than both measured run ranges
memory_gate: Primary held/peak heap at least40% lower; all other requested held/peak/bytes/calls must not increase
rss_gate: Median native peak RSS increase must fit baseline max-minus-min
limits: Linux System allocator component fixture, not Fincode mimalloc or GPU frame
No app-wide or macOS/Windows performance claim
fixed_overhead: None. AppDependencies fields and nonempty recording allocation sites stay unchanged. App construction is outside the recorder census.
